children.html: All-On-X Dental Implants in Santa Clarita
Regain a Full Smile with Just Four Implants—Led by Dr. Moezzi
Confident, Comfortable Smiles Start Here

Missing most or all of your teeth doesn’t mean you have to settle for loose dentures or multiple surgeries. At Valencia Smile Expert, we offer All-On-X dental implants in Santa Clarita—a revolutionary full-arch restoration that gives you a permanent, natural-looking smile using just four implants per jaw. Led by Dr. Moezzi, our team combines advanced technology, gentle care, and personalized attention to deliver same-day results that look and feel like your real teeth. If you’re ready to reclaim your bite, your confidence, and your quality of life, All-On-X may be the solution you’ve been waiting for.
What Are All-On-X Dental Implants?

All-On-X dental implants are a full-arch restoration solution that replaces an entire row of missing or failing teeth using just four strategically placed implants. Instead of placing an implant for every single tooth, this innovative approach uses the front implants vertically and the back implants at an angle to maximize contact with the jawbone—often eliminating the need for bone grafting. It’s a streamlined, stable, and long-lasting solution ideal for patients looking to transition away from removable dentures or restore their smile after significant tooth loss.
Key Benefits of All-On-X:

children.desc: Immediate function with same-day temporary teeth
Fewer implants, less invasive than traditional full-mouth solutions
Fixed (non-removable) for superior stability and confidence
Natural look, feel, and bite function
Easy to maintain with regular oral hygiene and dental checkups

children.html: Are You a Candidate for All-On-X?

Many patients who have been told they’re not eligible for traditional implants due to bone loss are excellent candidates for All-On-X. This technique is designed to work with existing bone structure and provide a long-lasting solution—even if you’ve worn dentures for years.

items.text: Are missing most or all of your upper or lower teeth
Struggle with loose or uncomfortable dentures
Have failing teeth due to decay, trauma, or gum disease
Have been told you need bone grafting for traditional implants
Are in good overall health and can undergo minor oral surgery
Want a permanent, natural-feeling alternative to dentures

children.html: During your consultation, Dr. Moezzi will assess your oral health, review digital scans, and help you decide if All-On-X is the best option for your smile and lifestyle.
What to Expect: The All-On-X Treatment Process

At Valencia Smile Expert, we make the All-On-X experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. From your initial scan to the moment you walk out with a brand-new smile, our team is here to guide you every step of the way.

children.title: Consultation & Digital Imaging
children.desc: We begin with a thorough exam, 3D CBCT scan, and full discussion of your goals. Dr. Moezzi evaluates your bone structure and designs a personalized surgical plan for precise implant placement.

children.title: Implant Placement & Temporary Restoration
children.desc: On procedure day, four implants are placed in the jaw—two in front, two angled in the back. A custom, same-day temporary bridge is secured so you leave the office with a functional, beautiful smile.

children.title: Healing & Final Prosthetic
children.desc: Over the next few months, the implants integrate with your jawbone. Once fully healed, we replace your temporary bridge with a permanent, custom-designed prosthetic that looks and functions like natural teeth.

children.html: Before & After All-On-X: How to Prepare and Recover

A successful All-On-X experience starts with thoughtful preparation and ends with proper post-op care. At Valencia Smile Expert, we provide clear guidance before and after your procedure so you can heal quickly and confidently.
Before Your Procedure:

items.text: Avoid smoking for at least a week beforehand, as it can hinder healing
Follow fasting instructions if sedation is being used
Disclose all medications and medical conditions during your consultation
Arrange for someone to drive you home if sedation will be administered
Maintain excellent oral hygiene leading up to the procedure

children.html: After Your Procedure:

items.text: Rest for 24–48 hours and avoid strenuous activity
Stick to soft foods like smoothies, mashed vegetables, and scrambled eggs
Use prescribed medications as directed to manage swelling or discomfort
Do not smoke, drink through a straw, or spit forcefully during early recovery
Clean gently around the surgical area with saltwater rinses and a soft brush
Attend follow-up appointments so we can monitor healing and progress

children.html: All-On-X Dental Implant FAQs

items.title: What makes All-On-X different from traditional dental implants?

children.html: All-On-X uses just four implants to support a full arch of teeth, while traditional implants may require 6–8 per arch and sometimes bone grafting. This technique is more efficient, often less invasive, and allows for same-day temporary teeth.

items.title: How long do All-On-X implants last?

children.html: With proper care, All-On-X dental implants can last 20 years or more. Good oral hygiene and routine dental visits are key to long-term success.
The procedure is performed under local anesthesia with optional sedation. Most patients report minimal discomfort afterward, which can be managed with over-the-counter or prescribed medication.

items.title: Can I eat normally with All-On-X implants?

children.html: Yes. After the healing phase and placement of your final prosthesis, you’ll be able to enjoy nearly all your favorite foods again—with improved bite strength and stability.

items.title: Am I too old for All-On-X implants?

children.html: Age isn’t usually a limiting factor. As long as you’re healthy enough for oral surgery and don’t have uncontrolled conditions (like diabetes or osteoporosis), you may be a candidate.

items.title: How much do All-On-X implants cost?

children.html: Costs vary based on case complexity, arch (upper, lower, or both), and materials used. We provide transparent pricing and financing options after your consultation.

items.title: Do I need bone grafting for All-On-X?

children.html: In many cases, no. All-On-X is specifically designed to maximize available bone, even in patients with some bone loss.

items.title: Where can I learn more about dental implants?

children.html: For a deeper understanding of dental implant procedures and their benefits, visit the American Academy of Implant Dentistry or give us a call to schedule your consultation.
